notes.aoi_calibration: Calibration measured for the whole region is applied to your drawn area. Treat small areas as indicative.
notes.artifact_share: About {artifact_share} of the raw change comes from the sensor switch.
notes.same_sensor: This period doesn't cross the {sensor_change_year} sensor change, so the two records should mostly agree.
notes.tolerance: A claim counts as matching when it is within {tolerance} percentage points of the corrected likely range.
notes.windows: Compared the average of {start_window} with the average of {end_window} ({window_years}-year windows centred on the chosen years, shortened at the edges of the record).

templates.cant_tell_missing: We can't tell. Satellite coverage is too thin in {missing_years}, inside the years this check compares, and missing data is never counted as zero.
templates.cant_tell_zero_start: We can't tell. One of the two records shows no satellite-detected burning activity in {place} in {start_window}, so a percentage change from those years has no meaning.
templates.contradicted: The record contradicts the claim. After correcting for the sensor change, satellite-detected burning activity in {place} changed by {h_mid} from {start_window} to {end_window} (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}), the opposite direction to the claimed {claimed}.
templates.holds_up: The claim holds up. After correcting for the sensor change, satellite-detected burning activity in {place} changed by {h_mid} from {start_window} to {end_window} (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}), in line with the claimed {claimed}.
templates.no_clear_change: The record shows no clear change. After correcting for the sensor change, satellite-detected burning activity in {place} changed by {h_mid} from {start_window} to {end_window} (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}), too small to support the claimed {claimed}.
templates.sensor_artifact: The claimed change looks like a sensor artifact. The raw record, as most people would compute it, shows {naive} from {start_window} to {end_window} in {place}, but after correcting for the sensor change there is no clear change (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}).
templates.stronger_than_claimed: The claim understates the change. After correcting for the sensor change, satellite-detected burning activity in {place} changed by {h_mid} from {start_window} to {end_window} (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}), more than the claimed {claimed}.
templates.weaker_than_claimed: The claim overstates the change. After correcting for the sensor change, satellite-detected burning activity in {place} changed by {h_mid} from {start_window} to {end_window} (likely range {h_lo} to {h_hi}), less than the claimed {claimed}.
